accepted_claims: deterministic candidate prerequisite ownership report construction
paired no-ownership/no-Ethernet prerequisite control report construction
source-backed rp1_eth clock, interrupt, PHY reset, PHY/MDIO, and DMA/descriptor prerequisite metadata
observed-window MACB_MID identity retained as context-only metadata
validators reject source-shape bypasses and forbidden ownership/readiness claims

interrupt delivery, handler ownership, or completion
DMA, descriptor rings, channel ownership, or transfer completion

source facts identify required prerequisites but not Talos ownership

any later hardware proof is limited to report visibility unless future scope supplies different acceptance criteria
